arxiv-1806-00300.title: Artificial Immune Systems Can Find Arbitrarily Good Approximations for the NP-Hard Number Partitioning Problem Journal: Journal of L a T e X Templates
arxiv-1806-00300.creator: Dogan Corus, Pietro S. Oliveto, Donya Yazdani
arxiv-1806-00300.description: Abstract Typical artificial immune system (AIS) operators such as hypermutations with mutation potential and ageing allow to efficiently overcome local optima from which evolutionary algorithms (EAs) struggle to escape. Such behaviour has been shown for artificial example functions constructed especially to show difficulties that EAs may encounter during the optimisation process.

arxiv-2203-07695.title: The scaling limit of the weakly self-avoiding walk on a high-dimensional torus
arxiv-2203-07695.creator: Emmanuel Michta
arxiv-2203-07695.description: Abstract We prove that the scaling limit of the weakly self-avoiding walk on a d d -dimensional discrete torus is Brownian motion on the continuum torus if the length of the rescaled walk is o ⁡ ( V 1 / 2 ) o(V^{1/2}) where V V is the volume (number of points) of the torus and if d > 4

arxiv-2210-14570.title: Wavefield reconstruction inversion modelling of Marchenko focusing functions
arxiv-2210-14570.creator: Ruhul F. Hajjaj, Sjoerd A.L. de Ridder, Philip W. Livermore, Matteo Ravasi
arxiv-2210-14570.description: Abstract Marchenko focusing functions are in their essence wavefields that satisfy the wave equation subject to a set of boundary, initial, and focusing conditions. Here, we show how Marchenko focusing functions can be modeled by finding the solution to a wavefield reconstruction inversion problem. Our solution yields all elements of the focusing function including evanescent, refracted, and trapped waves (tunneling).

arxiv-2405-17922.title: Stochastic Optimization Schemes for Performative Prediction with Nonconvex Loss
arxiv-2405-17922.creator: Qiang Li, Hoi-To Wai
arxiv-2405-17922.description: Abstract This paper studies a risk minimization problem with decision dependent data distribution. The problem pertains to the performative prediction setting in which a trained model can affect the outcome estimated by the model. Such dependency creates a feedback loop that influences the stability of optimization algorithms such as stochastic gradient descent (SGD).

arxiv-2409-01657.title: A novel machine learning method to detect double- Λ \Lambda hypernuclear events in nuclear emulsions
arxiv-2409-01657.creator: Yan He, Vasyl Drozd, Hiroyuki Ekawa, Samuel Escrig, Yiming Gao, Ayumi Kasagi, Enqiang Liu, Abdul Muneem, Manami Nakagawa, Kazuma Nakazawa, Christophe Rappold, Nami Saito, Takehiko R. Saito, Shohei Sugimoto, Masato Taki, Yoshiki K. Tanaka, He Wang, Ayari Yanai, Junya Yoshida, Hongfei Zhang
arxiv-2409-01657.description: Abstract A novel method was developed to detect double- Λ \Lambda hypernuclear events in nuclear emulsions using machine learning techniques. The object detection model, the Mask R-CNN, was trained using images generated by Monte Carlo simulations, image processing, and image-style transformation based on generative adversarial networks.

arxiv-2510-06466.title: Attention-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Portfolio Optimization
arxiv-2510-06466.creator: Pei Xue, Yuanchun Ye
arxiv-2510-06466.description: Abstract . We propose a deep-reinforcement learning framework for dynamic portfolio optimization that combines a Dirichlet policy with cross-sectional attention mechanisms. Unlike softmax- or projection-based approaches, the Dirichlet distribution enforces feasibility by construction, accommodates tradability masks, and provides a coherent geometry for exploration.

arxiv-2511-20395.title: Identifying environmental factors associated with tetrodotoxin contamination in bivalve mollusks using eXplainable AI
arxiv-2511-20395.creator: M.C. Schoppema, B.H.M. van der Velden, A. Hürriyetoğlu, M.D. Klijnstra, E.J. Faassen, A. Gerssen, H.J. van der Fels-Klerx
arxiv-2511-20395.description: Abstract Since 2012, tetrodotoxin (TTX) has been found in seafoods such as bivalve mollusks in temperate European waters. TTX contamination leads to food safety risks and economic losses, making early prediction of TTX contamination vital to the food industry and competent authorities.

arxiv-2603-14417.creator: Max Hellrigel-Holderbaum, Edward James Young

pmc-10515975.title: Screening of Ginkgo Individuals with Superior Growth Structural Characteristics in Different Genetic Groups Using Terrestrial Laser Scanning (TLS) Data
pmc-10515975.creator: Wen Gao, Xiaoming Yang, Lin Cao, Fuliang Cao, Hao Liu, Quan Qiu, Meng Shen, Pengfei Yu, Yuhua Liu, Xin Shen
pmc-10515975.description: With the concept of sustainable management of plantations, individual trees with excellent characteristics in plantations have received attention from breeders. To improve and maintain long-term productivity, accurate and high-throughput access to phenotypic characteristics is essential when establishing breeding strategies. Meanwhile, genetic diversity is also an important issue that must be considered, especially for plantations without seed source information.

pmc-11255795.title: A study of critically ill obstetric patients admitted to intensive care unit of a tertiary care hospital
pmc-11255795.creator: Wajeeha Syed, Nazia Liaqat, Muhammad Shehryar Ashraf, Nayab Khan
pmc-11255795.description: Objectives:To evaluate characteristics, indications, complications and outcome of obstetric patients admitted to ICU of tertiary care hospital in KPK, Pakistan.Methods:This descriptive study was conducted in department of OBGYN of Lady Reading Hospital, Peshawar from January 2021 till December 2021. A total of 62 patients were enrolled into the study using nonprobability consecutive sampling technique.

pmc-11353264.title: Cardiovascular Risk in Philadelphia-Negative Myeloproliferative Neoplasms: Mechanisms and Implications—A Narrative Review
pmc-11353264.creator: Samuel Bogdan Todor, Cristian Ichim, Adrian Boicean, Romeo Gabriel Mihaila
pmc-11353264.description: Myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPNs), encompassing disorders like polycythemia vera (PV), essential thrombocythemia (ET), and primary myelofibrosis (PMF), are characterized by clonal hematopoiesis without the Philadelphia chromosome. The JAK2 V617F mutation is prevalent in PV, ET, and PMF, while mutations in MPL and CALR also play significant roles.

pmc-11490053.title: General hospital patients’ attitude towards systematic health risk behavior screening and intervention
pmc-11490053.creator: Caroline Timm, Filipa Krolo-Wicovsky, Anika Tiede, Marie Spielmann, Beate Gaertner, Ulrich John, Jennis Freyer-Adam
pmc-11490053.description: BackgroundSystematic counseling on behavioral health risk factors (HRFs) may be suitable to promote health among general hospital patients. This study aimed to investigate the openness of patients towards systematic screening and intervention of HRFs, its relation to actual participation in a multi-behavioral intervention, and whether socio-economic characteristics, HRFs and health indicators are related to approval.

pmc-11496561.title: Barriers and Facilitators of Pediatric Obesity Prevention and Management (POPM) Programs in Korea: Focusing on the Questionnaire About the Linkage in Community Level
pmc-11496561.creator: Sujin Park, Hyo Seon Jeong, Young-Min Noh, Eungu Kang, Yong Hee Hong, Sochung Chung
pmc-11496561.description: BackgroundRecent global trends indicate a rise in pediatric obesity, reflecting patterns also observed in South Korea. Given its significant impact on chronic disease prevalence in adulthood, pediatric obesity poses potential societal challenges. For pediatric obesity-related prevention or management programs in community level to operate effectively, there needs to be a clear understanding of barriers and facilitators of the programs.

pmc-11499447.title: 3D cultivation of non-small-cell lung cancer cell lines using four different methods
pmc-11499447.creator: Karina Malmros, Nadi Kirova, Heike Kotarsky, Daniel Carlsén, Mohammed S.I. Mansour, Mattias Magnusson, Pavan Prabhala, Hans Brunnström
pmc-11499447.description: PurposeThe aim of this study was to set up reliable and reproducible culture conditions for 3D tumoroids derived from non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) cell lines to enable greater opportunity for successful cultivation of patient-derived samples.MethodsFour NSCLC cell lines, two adenocarcinomas (A549, NCI-H1975) and two squamous cell carcinomas (HCC-95, HCC-1588), were first cultured in traditional 2D settings.

pmc-11598973.title: Evaluation of Cryopreservation of Bovine Ovarian Tissue by Analysis of Reactive Species of Oxygen, Toxicity, Morphometry, and Morphology
pmc-11598973.creator: Camila Bizarro-Silva, Larissa Zamparone Bergamo, Camila Bortoliero Costa, Suellen Miguez González, Deborah Nakayama Yokomizo, Ana Carolina Rossaneis, Waldiceu Aparecido Verri Junior, Mateus José Sudano, Evelyn Rabelo Andrade, Amauri Alcindo Alfieri, Marcelo Marcondes Seneda, Stefano Cecchini Gualand
pmc-11598973.description: Simple SummaryThere is a growing demand for the development of optimal protocols for ovarian tissue cryopreservation in different animal models to enable the maintenance of cell morphology. Therefore, it is crucial to understand the effects of conservation on ovarian cell proliferation and apoptosis to improve follicular development after in vitro culture and/or ovarian tissue transplantation.

pmc-11619544.title: Effect of Interpregnancy Interval on Pregnancy Outcome in a Tertiary Care Centre: A Descriptive Cross-sectional Study
pmc-11619544.creator: Poonam Koirala, Ishita Koirala, Sunita Pun, Shweta Karna
pmc-11619544.description: Introduction:Interpregnancy interval has a major impact on the maternal and fetal health worldwide. Women with short interpregnancy interval show higher rates of low birth weight and preterm babies. So this study aimed to study the effect of interpregnancy interval on pregnancy outcomes.

pmc-12552730.title: Combining antigenic data from public sources gives an early indication of the immune escape of emerging virus variants
pmc-12552730.creator: Antonia Netzl, Sina Türeli, Eric B LeGresley, Barbara Mühlemann, Samuel H Wilks, Derek J Smith
pmc-12552730.description: The rapid spread of the Omicron BA.1 (B.1.1.529.1) SARS-CoV-2 (Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2) variant in 2021 resulted in international efforts to quickly assess its escape from immunity generated by vaccines and previous infections. Numerous laboratories published BA.1 neutralization data as preprints and reports.

pmc-12565611.title: Female Trans-Sphincteric Anterior Anal Fistula: Still an Unsolved Problem—Results from a Nationwide Cohort Study
pmc-12565611.creator: Alba Correa Bonito, Óscar Cano Valderrama, Manuel Muinelo Lorenzo, Begoña Ochoa Villalabeitia, Juan Ocaña Jiménez, Beatriz Martín Pérez, Lidia Cristóbal Poch, Tamara Fernández Miguel, Carlos Cerdán Santacruz, on behalf of Young Group of Spanish Coloproctology Association, Lior Segev
pmc-12565611.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Female trans-sphincteric anterior anal fistula is one of the most challenging fistulae because of the inherent risk of postoperative incontinence. The objective of this study is to analyze current surgical practices in these patients and their results. Methods: This study is a nationwide cohort retrospective study of all female patients with trans-sphincteric anterior anal fistula that were operated on in 2019.

pmc-12574125.title: Importance of early prehospital intervention in crush injury and compartment syndrome: a case report
pmc-12574125.creator: Zeyen Seah, Julie Wulandari
pmc-12574125.description: BackgroundCrush injuries are commonly associated with natural disasters or human-made mass casualty events, affecting millions annually. Reports on non-disaster-related cases are limited.Case presentationWe present the case of a non-disaster-induced crush injury in which a Chinese patient’s arm was trapped in a toilet drain for 15 hours.

pmc-12609159.title: iGlucoSnFR2: A genetically encoded fluorescent sensor for measuring intracellular or extracellular glucose in vivo in mouse brain
pmc-12609159.creator: Jonathan S. Marvin, Philipp Mächler, Chengbo Meng, Tayfun Ates, Ronak H. Patel, Raghabendra Adhikari, Monika A. Makurath, Zaneta Ku, Daniel Feliciano, Deniz Atasoy, Guohong Cui, David Kleinfeld, Timothy A. Brown
pmc-12609159.description: Continuous glucose monitors have proven invaluable for monitoring blood glucose levels for diabetics, but they are of limited use for observing glucose dynamics at the cellular (or subcellular) level. We have developed a second generation, genetically encoded intensity-based glucose sensing fluorescent reporter (iGlucoSnFR2).

pmc-13209424.title: Effects of Accelerated Fermentation on the Chemical Composition and Quality of Beer
pmc-13209424.creator: Marek Zdaniewicz, Szymon Lekowski, Aleksander Poreda, Robert Duliński
pmc-13209424.description: The objective of this study was to examine the impact of using a rotary jet head (RJH) on the biosynthesis of byproducts of yeast metabolism and their role in shaping the flavor and aroma profile of bottom fermentation beer (lager style). The tests were conducted on an industrial scale, with fermentation in 3800 hL fermentation tanks.

pmc-13233810.title: Thyroid hormones maintain parvalbumin neuron functions in the mouse neocortex
pmc-13233810.creator: Juan Ren, Suzy Markossian, Romain Guyot, Denise Aubert, Fabrice Riet, Jacques Brocard, Alice Descamps, Jiemin Wong, Dongdong Li, Bruno Cauli, Thierry Gallopin, Frédéric Flamant, Sabine Richard
pmc-13233810.description: SummaryParvalbumin-expressing GABAergic interneurons are crucial for maintaining excitation/inhibition balance in the neocortex. The postnatal maturation of parvalbumin neurons is highly sensitive to thyroid hormone deficiency. The present study addressed the role of thyroid hormones in mature parvalbumin neurons. Using genetically modified mouse models, we selectively disrupted thyroid hormone signaling in parvalbumin neurons after the onset of parvalbumin expression.

pmc-13286735.title: Putative Imprinting Control Regions with Aberrant Blood-Based DNA Methylation are Associated with Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk
pmc-13286735.creator: Annie J DiFrank, Bruce A Corliss, James J H Park, Molly Rogers, David A Skaar, Dereje D Jima, Michael Cowley, Susan K Murphy, Andrew Liu, Cynthia A Moylan, Cathrine Hoyo

pmc-13303018.title: Scale development and validation of social media mindfulness: evidence from Chinese Douyin users
pmc-13303018.creator: Mengyu Li, Hao Chen

pmc-13538340.title: A dimeric mRNA vaccine based on key-mutant and KP.3 RBDs induces broad-spectrum immunity and protects mice against JN.1 and XDV challenges
pmc-13538340.creator: Jiali Xu, Rui Peng, Longhai Yuan, Huan Zhang, Cong Tang, Yanan Zhou, Hao Yang, Yun Yang, Qing Huang, Junbin Wang, Hongyu Chen, Wenqi Quan, Baisheng Li, Qiangming Sun, Shuaiyao Lu
pmc-13538340.description: The continued antigenic evolution of SARS-CoV-2 Omicron subvariants has progressively eroded vaccine-elicited protective immunity, driving demand for next-generation candidates that confer broad-spectrum protection against phylogenetically divergent strains. Here we report the design and preclinical evaluation of SV, an mRNA vaccine encoding a heterodimeric receptor-binding domain (RBD) antigen.

pmc-13589119.title: Yeast-fermented feed improves growth and meat quality in meat duck: Integrated metabolomics and proteomics reveal amino acid metabolic mechanisms
pmc-13589119.creator: Yang Liu, Hailin Liu, Ping Deng, Chuang Li, Xuan Huang, Xu Zhang, Xiaolong Peng, Zhicai Li, Yan Hu, Chao Peng, Qiuzhong Dai
pmc-13589119.description: Fermented feed is increasingly used in monogastric animal production to support growth, but little is known about its effects on meat quality or the mechanisms drive these effects. We fed 240 one-day-old Cherry Valley ducks either a basal diet or the same diet supplemented with 5% yeast-fermented feed for 42 days.

pmc-13619595.title: Serological evidence uncovers undocumented mpox exposure in febrile patients in Nigeria
pmc-13619595.creator: Jolly A. Adole, Sandra E. Omaga, Precious E. Oyamendan, Utibe M. Dennis, Oluremi I. Ajayi, Amoge C. Ogu, Ifeoluwa O. Bejide, Johnson Okolie, Philomena Eromon, Christian T. Happi, Chinedu A. Ugwu
pmc-13619595.description: IntroductionThe monkeypox virus (MPXV) has become a global health threat, with rising cases reported globally. Since its re-emergence in 2017, Nigeria has experienced a sustained outbreak, underscoring the critical need for robust surveillance mechanisms to identify transmission dynamics. Despite this urgency, data regarding MPXV seroprevalence among patients seeking medical care in Nigeria remains scarce.

pmc-13678554.title: Compartment-specific redox modulation in migraine with aura: a systematic review of context-dependent mechanisms
pmc-13678554.creator: Fengyu Li, Qishen Duan, Yu Li, Yilang Tian, Lijuan Lu, Xin Xin, Guoliang Zhu, Ying Zhou, Fanyi Kong
pmc-13678554.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Preventive therapies for migraine with aura (MA) remain suboptimal, with 37–54% of patients failing to achieve a >50% reduction in migraine days despite calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP)-targeted therapies, while broad-spectrum antioxidants show inconsistent benefits. This gap suggests that indiscriminate reactive oxygen species (ROS) scavenging is insufficient, but emerging evidence indicates that ROS function as compartment-specific signaling molecules rather than uniform toxins.

pmc-13714616.title: Semaglutide vs. liraglutide and incidence of diabetes and cardiovascular disease: A target trial emulation using real‐world data
pmc-13714616.creator: Ethan J Cannon, Wendy Wang, Faye L Norby, Rob F Walker, Shalini Kulasingam, Lisa S Chow, Joel F Farley, Pamela L Lutsey
pmc-13714616.description: AimsThe glucagon‐like peptide‐1 receptor agonists (GLP‐1 RAs) semaglutide and liraglutide are approved for chronic weight management. Both drugs also have favourable effects on the risk of developing diabetes and cardiovascular disease (CVD) compared with placebo, but their comparative effectiveness for these outcomes is unclear.
